decisions.reason: Identifies the exact throwing expression, busy as AttachButton useState local and free identifier in AttachmentChips, and the dual gating (empty early return; plain-phase falsy guard evaluating busy) yielding ReferenceError.

Explains the slot-level error boundary unmounts the entire dock entry (not just the remove button), the attach button is a separate slot entry and survives, and the error is console-only with no user-facing banner.

Establishes the line exists in shipped v0.2.10 via fixture plus independent maintainer note; proposes rollback/re-add bisect and a minimal data-present plain-phase mount; flags diff inconsistencies (non-standard hunk header, dropped aria-label context line) and the hoisted imageItem out-of-scope defect; honestly notes the weak link about when v0.2.10 users were first affected rather than overclaiming.

Removes dangling busy or passes it as an explicit prop, preserving the phase guard; adds record?.items ?? [] and event.target.closest?.() hardening; moves the hoisted imageItem computation into the map callback where record/status are scoped; also rejects pseudo-fixes like typeof guards.

Proposes a data-present plain-phase render smoke asserting chip DOM and zero error-boundary capture, explains why empty-state smoke is a false negative and why parse-only node --check resolves no identifiers or executes the component, and requires a data-present slot smoke in pre-ship checks.
